propositions: Bedrock provider ignores AWS_REGION (standard AWS env var) and only consults REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, causing LLM operations to fail unless one of those is explicitly set
botocore does not check AWS_REGION env var during region resolution, so rebar must resolve the chain explicitly and pass region_name to boto3.Session to bypass this gap

New pure resolver function resolve_bedrock_region must return both region and source string (verbatim source label), implement precedence REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION, and treat empty strings as unset
Provider provenance record must add region and region_source keys when bedrock region resolves via rebar's chain; both keys absent for profile-only resolution and non-bedrock providers
Error message for missing region must name the full resolution chain (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, AWS_REGION, profile) and drop the stale AWS_REGION-does-not-work paragraph
Documentation (llm-framework.md, local-dev-env.md) and generated env-registry must reflect correct region resolution order and AWS_REGION availability
